Title: [Retrieve][Response] Verify V2 Retrieve on the PNR after Exchange returns the new itinerary, tickets and price.
Steps / Endpoint Chain: 1. Exchange (TC-RI-COMMIT-POS-01). 2. Retrieve with the same pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken, surName.
Expected Result: HTTP 200. Same pnr; itinerary = the reissued offer; tickets[] = the new ticket numbers returned by Exchange; price = the Exchange selectedOffer total.
Notes: Type: Functional | Technique: ST | Gate G0 - runnable with the shared Re-Issue collection.

Title: [Retrieve][Response] Verify V2 Retrieve after Exchange no longer shows the old tickets as active.
Steps / Endpoint Chain: 1. Record the ticket numbers before Exchange. 2. Exchange. 3. Retrieve the same pnr.
Expected Result: The old ticket numbers are absent from tickets[] or carry a non-active status (record the value); only the new tickets are active.
Notes: Type: Integration | Technique: ST | Gate G0 - runnable with the shared Re-Issue collection. Same PNR (SPEC §2.16): the original booking is updated in place. Old-ticket status value is UNKNOWN: record it.

Title: [Void][Response] Verify a reissued ticket can be voided within the void window.
Steps / Endpoint Chain: 1. V2 Void with the pnr and the new ticket numbers returned by Exchange. 2. Retrieve the pnr.
Expected Result: Void HTTP 200; Retrieve shows the new tickets voided. Record the state of the old (exchanged) tickets.
Notes: Type: Functional | Technique: ST | Gate G0 - runnable with the shared Re-Issue collection.
